courses.summary: 跨地中海天然氣管線是本課引用官方資料的真實工程背景。研究焦點為海峽分段輸送與交付責任介面；課程把公開可確認的地理與項目身分，和自行建立的物料、能量、庫存及故障診斷情境分開，要求學徒逐項提交計算、假設、驗證資料與適用範圍。
courses.summaryEn: Transmed is the real engineering context identified by the official source. The study focuses on segmented strait transmission and custody-transfer responsibilities, separating verified project identity and geography from authored material, energy, inventory and diagnostic scenarios. Learners submit calculations, assumptions, validation evidence and applicability limits.
